hook.en: When a family takes a home loan or sells gold, the money is not regular income: it changes what the family owns or owes. When the government borrows, sells shares of a public company, or builds a dam, the same idea applies. This is the capital account.
hook.kn: ಕುಟುಂಬ ಗೃಹಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ಚಿನ್ನ ಮಾರಿದಾಗ ಆ ಹಣ ನಿಯಮಿತ ಆದಾಯವಲ್ಲ; ಅದು ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಲವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದಾಗ, ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಷೇರು ಮಾರಿದಾಗ, ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಕಟ್ಟಿದಾಗ ಇದೇ ತತ್ವ. ಇದು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಖಾತೆ.

body.en: Capital receipts are receipts that either create a liability or reduce the assets of the government. Borrowings (from the public through market loans, from the RBI, from commercial banks and from abroad) create liabilities: these are debt-creating receipts. Recovery of loans given earlier and disinvestment (sale of shares in public sector enterprises) reduce assets: these are non-debt capital receipts. Small savings such as provident funds and post office deposits are also capital receipts.

narration.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾಲಗಳು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾಲ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಹಿಂತೆಗೆತ (ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳ ಷೇರು ಮಾರಾಟ) ಆಸ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ; ಇವು ಸಾಲೇತರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: Two tests for the capital account

narration.en: Two simple tests sort every item into the capital or the revenue account.

say.en: Ask one question about any receipt: does it create a liability or reduce an asset?
Borrowing creates a liability. Recovery of loans and disinvestment reduce assets.
For spending ask: does it create an asset or reduce a liability? Then it is capital expenditure.
An example: borrowings 900, recovery of loans 60, disinvestment 40.

prompt.en: Sort each item into the right part of the budget.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶವನ್ನು ಬಜೆಟ್‌ನ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Recovery of loans given to states

explanation.en: Capital receipts create a liability (borrowing) or reduce assets (disinvestment, loan recovery). Capital expenditure creates assets or reduces liabilities. Everything else is on the revenue side.

body.en: Capital expenditure is expenditure that either creates physical or financial assets or reduces the liabilities of the government. Examples: building roads, schools and hospitals; buying land, machinery and equipment; investment in shares of public enterprises; loans and advances given to states and others; and repayment of loans taken earlier.

points.en: Creates an asset or reduces a liability

narration.en: Capital expenditure is expenditure that either creates physical or financial assets or reduces the liabilities of the government. Examples: building roads, schools and hospitals; buying land, machinery and equipment; investment in shares of public enterprises; loans and advances given to states and others; and repayment of loans taken earlier.
narration.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಎಂದರೆ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ರಸ್ತೆ, ಶಾಲೆ, ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ; ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣ ಖರೀದಿ; ಷೇರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ; ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಲ; ಹಳೆಯ ಸಾಲದ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ.

caption.en: Capital receipts = borrowings + recovery of loans + disinvestment (illustrative, ₹ crore).

narration.en: Change the three parts of capital receipts. See how much of the total is new debt.

tryThis.en: At the default values, is the share of borrowings 90%?
Raise disinvestment. Does the government’s debt rise or not?

problem.en: From these items (₹ crore), find capital receipts, non-debt capital receipts and capital expenditure: borrowings 900; recovery of loans 60; disinvestment 40; construction of highways 500; loans to states 200; repayment of old loans 150; subsidies 300.

steps.en: Non-debt capital receipts = recovery of loans 60 + disinvestment 40 = 100.
Capital expenditure = highways 500 + loans to states 200 + repayment 150 = 850.
Subsidies (300) are revenue expenditure, so they are left out.

answer.en: Capital receipts ₹1,000 crore; non-debt capital receipts ₹100 crore; capital expenditure ₹850 crore.

homework.en: Explain why repayment of a loan is capital expenditure but interest on the same loan is revenue expenditure.

narration.en: Recap. Capital receipts create a liability or reduce an asset. Borrowings are debt-creating; recovery of loans and disinvestment are non-debt. Capital expenditure creates an asset or reduces a liability. Repayment of loans is capital expenditure; interest on loans is revenue expenditure.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಗಳು ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಾಲಗಳು ಸಾಲ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಸಾಲ ವಸೂಲಿ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಹಿಂತೆಗೆತ ಸಾಲೇತರ. ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾಲ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವೆಚ್ಚ; ಸಾಲದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಆದಾಯ ವೆಚ್ಚ.
